results.evidence: The new test tests/test_time_cost_ascii_digits.py parametrizes log-time with hours '١.٥' and log-cost with --date '٢٠٢٦-١١-١٦'. It asserts exit == EXIT_REFUSED (1), an 'error: <field>:' message on stderr, and zero rows in the activities table. events.py now uses [0-9] in _PLAIN_DECIMAL and _ISO_DATE. All 5 tests pass (uv run --offline pytest). I did not run the tests against the base events.py. The implementer says the hours case fails there and the date case was already refused later by date.fromisoformat.
